headline: School Blow for Lombard Families: From Nursery to Middle School It Is a 26 Million Increase
summary: Lombard families face an increase of about 25.8 million euros in total school spending for the next school year, bringing the total to about 1.24 billion euros.
why: Household spending on education is a component of regional consumer costs. Changes in these outlays can affect disposable income in Italy's most populous region.
